decisions.reason: It directly reinforces the firm's core proposition of secure second-channel communication and should be retained after only a short time on the market in a growing security software segment.
A mobile PDF digital signature function fits closely with the firm's identity, authorization and online signing direction, so management would likely continue it.
A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is highly aligned with the firm's cryptography and authentication strengths and supports demanding enterprise and regulatory use cases.
Secure email-to-app delivery extends the firm's cross-channel secure communication offering and is consistent with its strategy of binding web, mobile and messaging interactions.
Although more specialized, a QR-code-based hardware signature token still matches the firm's hardware-capable security portfolio and can serve compliance-sensitive customers.
A payment network security compliance suite builds on the firm's transaction security capabilities and addresses exactly the risk and compliance needs its target customers value.
